question: What will the first reported revenues after September 2026 be for the following companies? (Nvidia)

calls.reasoning: Nvidia guided Q3 FY27 revenue to $108.0B +/-2%; consensus ~$108.8-109.0B. Over the last four quarters actual revenue beat the guidance midpoint by 4.6-5.7% (57.0 vs 54, 68.1 vs 65, 81.6 vs 78, 96.2 vs ~91); earlier FY26 beats were ~2.6-3.9%. Applying a 3-6% beat gives ~$111-114.5B, median ~$113.2B. CEO Huang's resignation came after the quarter closed, so it doesn't change the reported revenue; the outlook already excludes China data-center revenue. Supply constraints are the main reason for a smaller beat. A beat of more than 7.4% (above $116B) is plausible but rare (~6%); a miss below $105B is negligible. No prediction market found on Polymarket, Manifold, Kalshi or bookmakers.
